skill.name: SimPO vs. DPO Comparative Evaluation
skill.description: Benchmark SimPO and DPO performance across standard evaluation suites (AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard) to validate performance parity and quantify resource efficiency trade-offs. Use this skill when deciding between SimPO and DPO for preference optimization, or when validating that SimPO achieves comparable results with lower computational overhead.
skill.skill_body:
Run SimPO and DPO on the same preference optimization task using AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard evaluation templates. Measure performance metrics (win rate, score) and resource utilization (compute time, memory). Compare results to confirm performance parity and document resource savings.

## Objective

Verify that SimPO achieves comparable performance to DPO with lower computational overhead
## Applicable Signals

- Multiple candidate methods available for preference optimization
- Evaluation infrastructure supports AlpacaEval 2 or Arena-Hard
- Resource constraints are a decision factor

## Contraindications

- DPO is already deployed in production
- Task requires DPO-specific features not available in SimPO
- Evaluation infrastructure does not support AlpacaEval 2 or Arena-Hard templates

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Set up evaluation environment', 'detail': 'Configure AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard evaluation suites with correct tokenizer versions and templates'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Train or obtain baseline models', 'detail': 'Prepare SimPO and DPO models trained on identical preference data'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Run SimPO evaluation', 'detail': 'Execute SimPO on AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard; record performance metrics and resource usage'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Run DPO evaluation', 'detail': 'Execute DPO on same benchmarks with identical settings; record performance metrics and resource usage'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Compare results', 'detail': 'Analyze performance parity and compute resource efficiency gains (time, memory, cost)'}
- {'step': 6, 'action': 'Document findings', 'detail': 'Generate benchmark report with performance metrics, resource utilization, and recommendation'}

## Constraints

- Both methods must be evaluated on identical tasks and datasets
- Use consistent tokenizer versions (e.g., pre-update Llama3 tokenizer for Llama3 models)
- Evaluation templates must match repository specifications

## Cautions

- Model choice affects results: Gemma models show less catastrophic forgetting on math tasks than Llama3 despite limited math data in training
- Ensure evaluation consistency between training and benchmarking phases

## Output Contract

- Benchmark report containing: (1) SimPO and DPO performance metrics across AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard (e.g., win rates, scores); (2) Resource utilization comparison (compute time, memory, cost); (3) Conclusion on performance parity and efficiency trade-off; (4) Recommendation for method selection based on task constraints
